description: TRON network overview: TRX price and market cap, DeFi TVL, daily active accounts, transactions and USDT transfers (latest complete day with 30-day change), current block height and TPS, energy and bandwidth prices, and Stake 2.0 energy per staked TRX. Use it for general "how is TRON doing" questions; for the cost of a USDT transfer prefer get_usdt_fee, which gives the full breakdown. Daily metrics update once a day (the last complete UTC day); price, block height and energy price refresh every few minutes.
